methodology: HEREDADO: port-marker AND |LOC delta| ≤15%. REESCRITO: port-marker AND >30% OR name-match AND >30%. ANÁLOGO: name-match AND 15-30% LOC AND no marker. NUEVO: MX60 has it, reflow does NOT. FALTA: reflow has it, MX60 does NOT.
